checkedAlternates.resolution: Ultrasonic Testing actively pulses sound waves into a part (group-3), whereas Acoustic Emission passively listens to stress-induced crack emissions under load (group-4).
Eddy current uses electromagnetic induction coils (group-3), rather than surface dye or iron-powder indicators (group-2).
